description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Delegation of Powers by the Public Service Commission in terms of Article 57(1) of the Constitution Amending Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 1941/41 dated 20.11.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification is about the delegation of powers by the Public Service Commission for matters including appointments, transfers, promotions, and disciplinary control of public officers (specifically Grama Niladhari Service officers and Circuit Bungalow Keepers). It deals with public service administration, recruitment, and personnel management, which falls squarely under the definition of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8).
